title: Finite-field Krasner quotients: isomorphism thresholds, characteristics, and censuses
summary: We study Krasner quotient hyperfields arising from finite fields, $F_q/G_r$, where $G_r\le F_q^\times$ has index $r$. Building on the structure theorem of Baker--Jin, we determine the characteristic and C-characteristic of all sufficiently large such quotients: they depend only on the parity of $r$ and, when $r$ is even, on the residue class of $q$ modulo $2r$. In particular, the two Baker--Jin stable classes for even $r$ are separated by characteristic $2$ versus $3$, while the C-characteristic is always $1$.
